tasks.short: Demonstrate solar equipment to customers or dealers.

steps.what: Set up the solar equipment for the demonstration.
Demonstrate the solar equipment to customers or dealers.
Note what the customer or dealer wants to see next.

tasks.design: The representative still sets up the equipment and shows how it works. The {CRM} only stores what the customer or dealer asked to see next, using fields that already exist. Native fields are tested before custom code. The demonstration is not a video in place of the visit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Interest after a demonstration was written on paper and often never reached the account.
tasks.enabler_now: A note field can hold the follow-up. Showing the equipment cannot move off the person.
tasks.still_hard: Equipment that fails on the day, and questions that become a design problem rather than a demonstration.
tasks.human_edge: The representative sees which part made the customer lean in.
tasks.altitude: Demonstrations stay on the week. Nothing about who may show the equipment changes.

reach.task: Show a customer how a service works before they buy
reach.learn: What they write down in the moment so the follow-up is specific

evidence.claim: Demonstrating equipment to a customer or a dealer stays with the person in the room. A note of interest can sit on the account.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from setting up the kit to a note of what they want next. Quoting is a different task.
Structured fields are product shown and the interest noted. The representative produces them. Fallback: if the field is awkward, the note is typed in the activity the account already has.
Test native {CRM} activity fields before custom code. Upkeep of 1 hour per 100 baseline hours covers those fields.
unknowns: Whether demonstrations are at the customer's site or in a showroom.
research_questions: What share of demonstrations leads to a quote request in the same week?

incremental.description: Keep the interest fields on the account

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the demonstration is the whole task and the note is scribbled anyway. High: only the note is quicker. The demonstration stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still site visits, demonstrations and customer conversations. Quotes and yield figures are calculated before the meeting. The representative can refuse to send a price or a saving the tariff rule did not produce.
reach: Insurance sales agents: which funding question needs a licensed credit conversation
Real estate sales agents: how a visit is written down before a price is discussed
skills_to_grow: Checking a yield figure against shading the model missed
Keeping consumer calls inside the opt-in list
Reading a drawing against a measurement
role.ambitious_version: Every quote starts from a tariff rule the representative will sign, and no consumer is called without an opt-in.
